toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

data.summary: Headset stand (synthetic demo product) with demo-direct rule as of 2026-10-24. Undiscounted scenario: at the requested 5% revenue margin, the draft price is BRL 31.38 and contribution is BRL 1.58, so contribution is positive. Discounted scenario: with a 10% discount applied to that draft price, the charged price falls to BRL 28.24 and contribution becomes BRL -1.25, so contribution turns negative and the requested revenue margin is not retained. Note: markup on production cost is not the same as revenue margin.
assumptions: Product and rule are both demonstration data with statuses/provenance marked as synthetic/demonstration.
All charges are applied on the same revenue basis used by the deterministic table: 10% channel fee, 0% tax, 0% advertising, plus BRL 2 fixed fee.
Discount is applied to the recommended list price, not to costs.
Failure provision is included per the stored failure-rate model; it assumes full-print retry cost treatment as represented in the deterministic table.
Markup on production cost is reported separately from revenue margin and should not be treated as the same metric.
limitations: Full-print retry assumption is embedded in the stored cost model and may differ from actual operations.
Marketplace fee/verification is synthetic; there is no live marketplace validation for this rule.
Prices are draft recommendations only and require human approval; no publication or application is possible.
